name: no-sdr
description: Multi-user WebSDR server for RTL-SDR dongles — real-time waterfall, stereo FM, AM/SSB/CW, digital mode decoding

scripts.dev:go:demo: cd serverng && PATH="$PATH:$HOME/go/bin" NODE_SDR_DEMO=1 LOG_LEVEL=debug air
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:go
scripts.build:go: cd serverng && CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -ldflags="-s -w" -o bin/serverng ./cmd/serverng
scripts.build:go:native: cd serverng && CGO_ENABLED=0 GOAMD64=v3 go build -ldflags="-s -w" -o bin/serverng ./cmd/serverng
scripts.build:go:opus: cd serverng && go build -tags opus -ldflags="-s -w" -o bin/serverng ./cmd/serverng
scripts.build:go:opus:native: cd serverng && GOAMD64=v3 go build -tags opus -ldflags="-s -w" -o bin/serverng ./cmd/serverng
scripts.build:go:full: cd serverng && go build -tags "opus rtlsdr" -ldflags="-s -w" -o bin/serverng ./cmd/serverng
scripts.build:go:full:native: cd serverng && GOAMD64=v3 go build -tags "opus rtlsdr" -ldflags="-s -w" -o bin/serverng ./cmd/serverng
scripts.build:go:production: cd serverng && mkdir -p internal/api/static && cp -r ../client/dist internal/api/static/dist && go build -tags "production opus rtlsdr" -ldflags="-s -w -X main.version=$(npm pkg get version | tr -d '"')" -o bin/serverng ./cmd/serverng && rm -rf internal/api/static/dist
scripts.build:go:production:native: cd serverng && mkdir -p internal/api/static && cp -r ../client/dist internal/api/static/dist && GOAMD64=v3 go build -tags "production opus rtlsdr" -ldflags="-s -w -X main.version=$(npm pkg get version | tr -d '"')" -o bin/serverng ./cmd/serverng && rm -rf internal/api/static/dist
scripts.build:go:production:win: cd serverng && mkdir -p internal/api/static && cp -r ../client/dist internal/api/static/dist && CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 go build -tags "production" -ldflags="-s -w -X main.version=$(npm pkg get version | tr -d '"')" -o bin/serverng-windows-amd64.exe ./cmd/serverng && rm -rf internal/api/static/dist
scripts.build:production: npm run build:client && npm run build:go:production
scripts.build:production:native: npm run build:client && npm run build:go:production:native
scripts.build:production:win: npm run build:client && npm run build:go:production:win
scripts.build:rust:native: cd serverrs && RUSTFLAGS="-C target-cpu=native" cargo build --release --features opus
